evidence: Source inspection of the frozen bytes: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean; test.sh, .dockerignore, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml and environment/Dockerfile likewise). tests/Dockerfile:16-22 pins the judge CLI @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 (matches task.toml:31 REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code), @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1; :31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; :33-38 installs Chromium through the Playwright build bundled with the pinned MCP package (so the browser revision is fixed transitively) and links it to /usr/local/bin/chromium, the exact path every judge.toml passes as --executable-path (e.g. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:11-12). :1-4 copies Node 22 /usr/local into python:3.12-slim, giving node for the app and /usr/local/bin/python3 for the restart server (functional/judge.toml:17-18). :12-13 installs procps and util-linux, which supply setsid/setpriv used by test.sh:104-111. NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules at Dockerfile:9 matches test.sh:106 and environment/Dockerfile:3. The reference app requires only express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins (package.json dependencies express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1; index.html loads no off-origin asset), the same versions as in both images (environment/Dockerfile:9-11). Dockerfile:43-44 copies /tests and makes test.sh executable. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json records scripted golden runs in image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair as uid 65534; recomputed sha256 of results/server.log (6752f461...) and results/live-desk.json (abb06ce3...) match the index, and server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000', so the app launch half is observed in a verifier-type image. Not measured: no configured test.sh/RewardKit judge run exists for these frozen bytes (the index itself states full configured grading is absent), so claude-code + playwright-mcp + restart MCP actually grading is unexercised; I also could not tie that image tag to the frozen tests/ bytes, and no fresh image build was performed in this review (no containers started per constraints). Latent, template-controlled reproducibility caveats only (no observed impact): base tags node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim are not digest-pinned, apt packages are unversioned, and Dockerfile:41 patches rewardkit/agents.py behind an assert that would break the build if 0.1.7 content differed. Counterexample probes: a broken app cannot benefit from this row (image content is submission-independent); a conforming alternative that uses an npm package outside express/better-sqlite3 would fail to start in the verifier unless it vendors node_modules under /app, which test.sh:92 copies and :72-83 permits; this is the shared template runtime policy, not a task-added defect. Risk stays true solely because full verifier launch-and-grade runtime evidence is missing.
